description: This file defines the LeavePeriodAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing and retrieving leave period data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to get the current leave period, list all leave periods, and update the leave period settings.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPI
classes.description: API class for managing leave periods, including retrieving current leave period details, listing all leave periods, and updating the leave period configuration.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period, providing its details and whether it is defined.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all generated leave periods, indicating if a leave period is defined and providing the current leave period.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the leave period settings with provided start day and month, and enables leave module menu items if not previously configured.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Helper method to get the current leave period data if defined, normalized for API response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules applicable when retrieving a single leave period.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing all leave periods.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating leave period data, including validation for start day and month.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as creation is not supported by this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as creation is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as deletion is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as deletion is not supported.
